sources.locator: git grep at 8b5714a6f95612d2e829d5fe994670fd70bd5926 of Alas/, Mobile/, Packages/, AlasHelper/, AlasCLI/, relay/, plugins/ and Config/, and of mrmans0n/alas-plugins at 46933b1c02935b0fce93df6e4acb057e41ee47c2, for telemetry, analytics, PostHog, Segment (segment.io/segment.com/@segment), Sentry, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Bugsnag, Datadog, Crashlytics, crash report/crashreport, gtag and google-analytics (case-insensitive git grep; lockfiles and minified vendor bundles noted separately); Packages/AlasCore/Sources/AlasModel/Persistence/AppConfig.swift lines 220-242 and 747; whole-tree grep for crashReports and usageAnalytics
sources.finding: No ADE-vendor analytics or crash sender appears. Matches are a Sentry entry in the terminal-app catalog, local simulator/device log and crash-report reading for the developer's own apps, CUA_TELEMETRY=0 passed to a VM guest tool, comments about token/time counters and future telemetry, and syntax-highlighting/prose words. AppConfig general.crashReports and general.usageAnalytics default to false, but outside AppConfig they appear only in tests, plans and a demo-profile script; no sender or settings control reads them. alas-plugins has no matches.
